title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: fit of the goods at the decision — containers and gross weight
content:
## Rule
When a review of the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product is decided, the goods fit the category only if, on the acceptance as it stands at the decision, the container count does not exceed the category's maximum containers per acceptance, and the declared gross weight does not exceed the category's maximum gross weight per acceptance and, divided evenly over the containers, does not exceed the category's maximum gross weight per container.

## The three comparisons
| Figure on the acceptance | Compared with | Passes when |
|---|---|---|
| container count | maximum containers per acceptance | not above it |
| declared gross weight | maximum gross weight per acceptance | not above it |
| declared gross weight divided evenly over the containers | maximum gross weight per container | not above it |

## Worked cases (hypothetical ceilings: 4 containers, 50000 kg per acceptance, 19000 kg per container)
| Containers | Declared gross weight | Weight per container | Fits |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 48000 kg | 16000 kg | yes |
| 3 | 57300 kg | 19100 kg | no — above both weight ceilings |
| 2 | 39000 kg | 19500 kg | no — above the per-container ceiling although within 50000 kg |
| 5 | 45000 kg | 9000 kg | no — above 4 containers |

## Points of judgement
- *An amended declaration raised the weight before the decision — which weight is tested?* The declared gross weight on the acceptance as it stands at the decision.
